Seven comments

Anneliese

Not an Irish tune but something you might enjoy along with a few “steins” at a Beef Fest.

It’s actually very catchy and fun to play. I believe it is also a song.

Described as a March/Polka, I posted it here as a march so I could use the 4/4 timing

↳ Posted by 🎻 Melody Player 🎻 on November 25th, 2022.

Anneliese, X:2

I’ve noticed that quite a few accordionists etc seem to play this in F & B flat. So, I’ve added another setting.

Have fun.
:-)

Re: Anneliese

I played the audio for these and notice it ignored the tied notes. Is this a glitch that needs reporting or am I missing something?

↳ Posted by Graham Shaw on December 10th, 2022.

Re: Anneliese

Yes, I noticed that too.

It’s to do with the coding, I think.
I’m not sure if using the “-” as in A-B for example would help but, from previous experience, I think this causes even more issues with the midi and brackets are usually preferred.
Maybe a combination of both might work, I’m not sure?
I’ll have another look.

↳ Posted by 🎻 Melody Player 🎻 on December 10th, 2022.

Re: Anneliese

It’s because the ties have been written as slurs, for example, (G G) instead of G- G. They look the same on the score but sound different on the audio.

It’s unfortunately a quite common error.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on December 10th, 2022.

Re: Anneliese

I don’t know if this will help, but I notice your tied indicator, the hyphen, is quite long, a tiny bit longer than in your post just above. My laptop sometimes automatically swaps my short hyphen - for a longer one – that isn’t recognised by the ABCconverter (at least the mandolintab.net/ABCconverter, that seems to have stopped working again for me & I had to swap to EasyABC instead!). I have to swap the hyphen back again each time. It does it with my laptop’s apostrophe as well. It might not be that but its just a suggestion. The other poster went on while I was writing this so I didn’t see it in time!

↳ Posted by Graham Shaw on December 10th, 2022.

Re: Anneliese

Yes, I’ve managed to fix it although I left the brackets in this time. It plays OK now though.

Thanks, I’ll know for again.

It was actually because I made that mistake with the slurs before that I stuck with the brackets. Obviously, it’s just a case of remembering…. “-” for ties and “( )” for slurs.

Graham, I think it may change size when it’s converted? It’s the only hyphen on my keyboard. The other one on the key is the underscore.
